issue_request: FHIR-37643 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested optional Series Number and Instance Number support in ImagingSelection: add top-level seriesNumber, add an optional unsignedInt instance number under instance with a note distinguishing instance and frame numbers, and add DICOM mappings to Series Number and Instance Number respectively.

The remaining gap was that the instance number mapping used Instance Number (0020,0011), which is the Series Number tag.
additional_context: ImagingSelection is active in source/fhir.ini.
